title: Newie Y NDE 253
content: I had had attacks before and always recovered, this time I could tell I wasn't. In effect, you strangle. I had somehow hooked myself through a window in the bathroom to try to breathe better I guess. Anyhow, as a result when I passed out I didn't fall down. A short peaceful time passed, as I was no longer struggling for air. Then I was outside the window (we were on the thirty-seventh floor) looking back on me passed out in the window. My hand was reaching out to the me in the window. The night was dark but the stars were getting lighter eating up the night. I felt an urgency to take the me in the window with me, touch her, or get her attention. I'm not sure. But she was out. Didn't see me. I turned to go -- into the sky, night, light. Not sure. Just that that person in the window had nothing to do with me anymore. There was no sound. Maybe whooshing. But this is New York. There is always sound. This was quiet, Very quiet. Then I heard this colossal noise. Someone was beating the door to the bathroom down. I turned around. My husband came in and started trying to get a response out of the old me. Then there were emergency medical technicians, workers, and other people. He looked horrified. I felt very sad -- the me outside the window. I lingered. I didn't fly away. Then pop. Just like before, no transition, first I was one place then the other. I was then inside my eyes and me were seeing the ceiling not the night. The clarity of this memory is not to be denied in spite of my not religious views. It was not fuzzy. I told those closest to me within a day.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Outside the bathroom window on the thirty-seventh floor, looking back at her body passed out in the window; turned to go into the sky/night/light.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Very quiet; no sound except maybe whooshing; felt urgency to get the body's attention; felt very sad seeing husband horrified.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark night with stars getting lighter 'eating up the night'; very quiet.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Strangling/asphyxiation during an attack; passed out while hooked through a bathroom window trying to breathe.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard colossal noise of husband beating door down; observed husband and EMTs; 'pop' instant return into eyes/body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE outside window with attempt to move into sky/night/light, then attention pulled back by noise and husband/EMTs, then instant 'pop' return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She was hooked through a bathroom window on the thirty-seventh floor and found herself outside the window with her hand reaching toward her unconscious body; stars 'getting lighter eating up the night'; return described as a sudden 'pop' with no transition.
